title: Authentication: setup project + storageState
summary: Log in once in a setup project, save cookies/localStorage with storageState, and start every other test already signed in.
why: UI login in every test is slow and makes the whole suite fail when login breaks. Saved state turns login into a one-time precondition.
body:
Config: a 'setup' project with testMatch /.*\.setup\.ts/, and your browser projects with dependencies: ['setup'] and use: { storageState: 'playwright/.auth/user.json' }. The setup test logs in, waits for the post-login page, then calls page.context().storageState({ path }). Add playwright/.auth to .gitignore. For multiple roles, save one file per role and pick with test.use({ storageState }). API login (request.post + storageState) is even faster.

This lesson's lab runs with the hub's auth preset: auth.setup.ts below is provided and runs first.
objectives: Configure a setup project and dependencies
pitfalls: Saving state before the redirect completes.
Tests that log out while sharing one saved session (they break each other).
